# Glossary of Sales Terms

## Grand total

The full amount of an invoice, including all line items.

## Amount paid

The part of the invoice total the customer has already paid.

## Outstanding amount

The part of an invoice still unpaid: the grand total minus the amount paid. A customer owes money when their outstanding amount is above zero.

## Due date

The last day the customer can pay without the invoice becoming overdue. Under standard terms this is 30 days after the invoice date.

## Sales order and sales invoice

A sales order records what a customer agreed to buy. A sales invoice is the bill sent for that order.
